l2_api: type JSONRPCError struct { Code int; Message string }
l4_api: func parseMCPMaxToolCalls(raw string, present bool) (*int, error)

semantics.legacy_unlimited: NewToolCallBudget(nil) never rejects tools/call for exhaustion and preserves the legacy forwarding surface.
semantics.positive_limit: A positive N admits exactly the first N syntactically dispatched tools/call requests to decodeAndForward.
semantics.pre_effect_boundary: For tools/call N+1 and every later tools/call, Dispatch returns the exhaustion error without invoking decodeAndForward; therefore decoding, handler entry, network I/O and durable mutation cannot occur.
semantics.accounting: Each admitted tools/call consumes one unit before decodeAndForward, including callbacks that later report invalid params or handler error. Rejected calls do not invoke the callback.
semantics.non_calls: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list and every method other than tools/call invoke decodeAndForward but neither consume nor reset the process-instance tool-call counter, including when interleaved after one or more admitted tools/call requests.
semantics.counter_scope: Counter state belongs to one ToolCallBudget instance and is shared across all tool names behind tools/call. It is neither per tool/method nor package-global.
semantics.dispatch_model: Sequential stdio only; concurrent Dispatch calls are outside this focal contract.
semantics.configuration: L4 uses os.LookupEnv for BATEIA_MCP_MAX_TOOL_CALLS and passes raw/present to parseMCPMaxToolCalls before constructing or serving MCP.
semantics.configuration_absent: present=false returns (nil,nil), selecting legacy unlimited mode regardless of raw placeholder value.
semantics.configuration_positive: present=true with canonical ASCII decimal digits denoting 1..max-int returns a pointer to that integer.
semantics.configuration_invalid: present=true with empty, zero, negative, signed, whitespace-padded, fractional, overflow or non-decimal input returns non-nil error and nil limit.
semantics.fail_closed: A parse or NewToolCallBudget error is returned from MCP wiring before Serve; no request may be read or response emitted.
semantics.receipt_boundary: External execution receipts count MCP tools/call attempts separately from callbacks admitted by Dispatch. This component exposes no model and executes no agent.

positive_controls: unlimited legacy forwards repeated tools/call requests
limit N forwards calls 1 through N
non-call methods do not consume N
two budget instances have independent counters
negative_controls: call N+1 returns exact -32010 and sanitized message
counter cannot reset by changing downstream tool label
counter cannot leak between server instances

focal_mutants.mutation: admit call N+1 or reject call N
maintain a distinct counter for each downstream tool label or reset across non-call methods
share consumption between independent server budget instances

invalidation: Any byte change to an input, API, error code/message, counting boundary, configuration grammar or oracle invalidates this candidate contract and requires focal resealing.
limitations: The contract covers the deterministic forwarding/configuration boundary, not behavioral uplift.
Shared filesystem and inherited history prevent strong isolation attestation.
A design mutation score is not an executed mutation score; independent verification remains required.
